# Windows Portable Devices headers

Unmodified headers from mingw-w64 v12.0.0. The corresponding IDL files and portabledevice.h are in the Public Domain; LICENSE preserves DISCLAIMER.PD from that release.

These headers are used when the Windows toolchain lacks the WPD headers or configuration-manager notification declarations.

- portabledeviceapi.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/v12.0.0/mingw-w64-headers/include/portabledeviceapi.h
  SHA-256: ab15dd0867eced15cd12e98f809312ffa1c42fd1840b5ff31cf2c59209751d20
- portabledevice.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/v12.0.0/mingw-w64-headers/include/portabledevice.h
  SHA-256: 893f0b515a4a216ada26a6f60bab1232dcc453fb65a6f52c91fe670835225aaf
- portabledevicetypes.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/v12.0.0/mingw-w64-headers/include/portabledevicetypes.h
  SHA-256: 6e82dc790c4a49245b498748f37958062e51bfead34348c188f5a3dfaad1198c
- cfgmgr32.h: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/v12.0.0/mingw-w64-headers/include/cfgmgr32.h
